data.content_ref: inline:KIND: Integration. The isolated problem integrates the 'negative probability' of SRC_003 with the 'verisimilitude' of SRC_001 into a dual-aspect monism. RELATION: Preference is simultaneously a procedural elimination (SRC_003) and a rational bet on truth-likeness (SRC_001); they are two descriptions of the same event. REFUTED IF: It is demonstrated that one can logically hold the procedural view without committing to any notion of truth-likeness, or vice versa, proving they are not integrated but independent.
